exported_fields.name: input
exported_fields.description: A value other components can use to send telemetry data to.

batcher.description: Configures batching requests based on a timeout and a minimum number of items.

otel_to_hec_fields.description: Configures mapping of OpenTelemetry to HEC Fields.

arguments.name: token
arguments.description: Splunk HEC Token.

arguments.name: disable_compression
arguments.description: Disable Gzip compression.

arguments.name: export_raw
arguments.description: Send only the logs body when targeting HEC raw endpoint.

arguments.name: health_check_enabled
arguments.description: Used to verify Splunk HEC health on exporter startup.

arguments.name: health_path
arguments.description: Path for the health API.

arguments.name: index
arguments.description: Splunk index name.

arguments.name: log_data_enabled
arguments.description: Enable sending logs from the exporter. One of log_data_enabled or profiling_data_enabled must be true.

arguments.name: max_content_length_logs
arguments.description: Maximum log payload size in bytes. Must be less than 838860800 (~800MB).

arguments.name: max_content_length_metrics
arguments.description: Maximum metric payload size in bytes. Must be less than 838860800 (~800MB).

arguments.name: max_content_length_traces
arguments.description: Maximum trace payload size in bytes. Must be less than 838860800 (~800MB).

arguments.name: max_event_size
arguments.description: Maximum event payload size in bytes. Must be less than 838860800 (~800MB).

arguments.name: profiling_data_enabled
arguments.description: Enable sending profiling data from the exporter. One of log_data_enabled or profiling_data_enabled must be true.

arguments.name: source_type
arguments.description: Splunk source type.

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Splunk source.

arguments.name: splunk_app_name
arguments.description: Used to track telemetry for Splunk Apps by name.

arguments.name: splunk_app_version
arguments.description: Used to track telemetry by App version.

arguments.name: use_multi_metrics_format
arguments.description: Use multi-metrics format to save space during ingestion.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.description: Whether to not enqueue batches before sending to the consumerSender.

arguments.name: flush_timeout
arguments.description: The time after which a batch will be sent regardless of its size.

arguments.name: max_size
arguments.description: The maximum size of a batch. If the batch exceeds this value, it’s broken up into smaller batches. Must be greater than or equal to min_size. Set this value to zero to disable the maximum size limit.

arguments.name: min_size
arguments.description: The minimum size of a batch.

arguments.name: sizer
arguments.description: The unit of measure for the batch size. Must be one of items, bytes, or requests.

arguments.name: interval
arguments.description: Time interval for the heartbeat interval, in seconds.

arguments.name: startup
arguments.description: Send heartbeat events on exporter startup.

arguments.name: severity_number
arguments.description: Maps severity number field to a specific HEC field.

arguments.name: severity_text
arguments.description: Maps severity text field to a specific HEC field.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.description: Enable telemetry inside the exporter.

arguments.name: override_metrics_names
arguments.description: Override metrics for internal metrics in the exporter.

nested_blocks.description: Configures batching requests based on a timeout and a minimum number of items.
Configures mapping of OpenTelemetry to HEC Fields.

client.description: Configures the HTTP client used to send data to Splunk HEC.

arguments.name: endpoint
arguments.description: The Splunk HEC endpoint to use.

arguments.name: disable_keep_alives
arguments.description: Disable HTTP keep-alive.

arguments.name: idle_conn_timeout
arguments.description: Time to wait before an idle connection closes itself.

arguments.name: insecure_skip_verify
arguments.description: Ignores insecure server TLS certificates.

arguments.name: max_conns_per_host
arguments.description: Limits the total (dialing,active, and idle) number of connections per host. Zero means no limit

arguments.name: max_idle_conns_per_host
arguments.description: Limits the number of idle HTTP connections the host can keep open.

arguments.name: max_idle_conns
arguments.description: Limits the number of idle HTTP connections the client can keep open.

arguments.name: read_buffer_size
arguments.description: Size of the read buffer the HTTP client uses for reading server responses.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.description: Time to wait before marking a request as failed.

arguments.name: write_buffer_size
arguments.description: Size of the write buffer the HTTP client uses for writing requests.

debug_metrics.description: Configures the metrics that this component generates to monitor its state.

queue.description: Configures batching of data before sending.

retry_on_failure.description: Configures retry mechanism for failed requests.
